paper_metadata.title: Mini-Gemini: Mining the Potential of Multi-modality Vision Language Models
paper_metadata.abstract: In this work, we introduce Mini-Gemini, a simple and effective framework enhancing multi-modality Vision Language Models (VLMs). Despite the advancements in VLMs facilitating basic visual dialog and reasoning, a performance gap persists compared to advanced models like GPT-4 and Gemini. We try to narrow the gap by mining the potential of VLMs for better performance and any-to-any workflow from three aspects, i.e., high-resolution visual tokens, high-quality data, and VLM-guided generation. To enhance visual tokens, we propose to utilize an additional visual encoder for high-resolution refinement without increasing the visual token count. We further construct a high-quality dataset that promotes precise image comprehension and reasoning-based generation, expanding the operational scope of current VLMs. In general, Mini-Gemini further mines the potential of VLMs and empowers current frameworks with image understanding, reasoning, and generation simultaneously. Mini-Gemini supports a series of dense and MoE Large Language Models (LLMs) from 2B to 34B. It is demonstrated to achieve leading performance in several zero-shot benchmarks and even surpasses the developed private models. Code and models are available at https://github.com/dvlab-research/MiniGemini.

extraction_data.organization: The Chinese University Of Hong Kong, Smartmore
extraction_data.innovation: Introduces a unified any-to-any VLM framework supporting both text-image understanding and generation. Uses a dual-resolution vision encoder (ViT-L for LR, ConvNeXt-L for HR) with a patch info mining projector. Bridges the domain gap between LLM text embeddings and diffusion models by translating instructions into high-quality text prompts for SDXL, rather than aligning embedding spaces.
extraction_data.pretraining_task: Visual instruction tuning, image-text alignment, generation
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: High-quality datasets from diverse public sources (task-oriented instructions, generation-related data, high-quality responses)
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Instruction tuning, re-captioning activation, Visual instruction tuning
extraction_data.extension: Mini-Gemini-HD variant introduces dynamic resolution image processing to improve high-resolution understanding.
extraction_data.research_problem: Bridging the performance gap between academic VLMs and advanced proprietary models (GPT-4, Gemini) by mining VLM potential for better performance and any-to-any workflow.
extraction_data.application: Visual understanding, image generation, text-to-image captioning, OCR reasoning, chart analysis, code generation from plots
extraction_data.paper_title: Mini-Gemini: Mining the Potential of Multi-modality Vision Language Models
extraction_data.training_corpus_size: ~1.2M image captions, ~1.5M instruction conversations, 13K generation instructions
extraction_data.finetuning_data: 13K pure text data, high-quality responses, task-oriented instructions, generation-related data, ShareGPT4V, LAION-GPT-4V, OCR-specific data, ALLaVA dataset, LLaVA-filtered CC3M, ALLaVA, LLaVA, LIMA, OpenAssistant2, DocVQA, ChartQA, DVQA, AI2D
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Dual-encoder attention mechanism (low-res generates visual queries, high-res provides candidate keys/values)
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Modality alignment (projector pretraining) -> Instruction tuning -> Generation tuning
extraction_data.moe_configuration: Supports both dense and MoE LLMs (2B-34B)
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: Information mining from existing VLMs (LLaVA, ShareGPT4V, etc.) and GPT-4V for captions and prompts
extraction_data.fusion_architecture: Dual-encoder visual token enhancement (low-res queries + high-res keys/values via attention)
extraction_data.vision_encoder: Dual-encoder system (one for high-resolution images, one for low-resolution visual embedding), ConvNeXt-L, CLIP-pretrained ViT-L (LR), LAION-pretrained ConvNeXt-L (HR), SigLIP
